jobs.title: Product Manager – AI Agents & Atlassian Cloud
jobs.description: You care about why people need a product and enjoy discovering how to make it more useful. At XALT, product work stays close to customer projects: at least half of your time is spent as a Product Owner or consultant on billable client work. What you learn there helps shape our own products. What we are working towards We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on. What you will work on Develop product ideas for XALT Northstar, AI agents on Atlassian Cloud, developer experience and integrations such as CollabLayr. Investigate customer problems, prioritise requirements and turn them into clear product decisions. Work with engineering and consulting on prototypes, releases and learning from usage. Support delivery as a Product Owner or consultant for clients, with at least 50% billable time. What you bring Experience in software product management or product ownership and an interest in direct client work Understanding of cloud products, integrations and the possibilities of Rovo, Forge or MCP An AI prototype you built yourself , with benefits and limitations you can explain and demonstrate What we offer Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools €70,000–95,000 gross per year Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution Your working arrangements We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role. Our professional community Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte. Your AI example We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code. Your application Does this sound like work you would enjoy? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to ----- and tell us what you would like to work on. The conversation should also give you room to ask about the team, your responsibilities and what you need to do good work. We will discuss the interview arrangements and your AI demonstration with you personally. You can also send any questions beforehand to ----- Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Neobank App
jobs.description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads. What You'll Own Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas. Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads. Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution. Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services. Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions. Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement. Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement. What We're Looking For Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features. Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes. Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing. Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage. Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure. Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Can set direction and still go deep into details. Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality. Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no. Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy. Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams. This Role Is Not For Product leaders who only manage people and meetings. People who cannot go deep into product details. Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment. Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact. People who need large teams before they can create progress. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
